latest_release.name: Anti-Defensive Writing — Codex plugin v1.0.0
latest_release.body:
Package the existing Chinese and English Anti-Defensive Writing skills as a Codex plugin, published by Adkid-Zephyr. Includes portable and Codex manifests, a repository marketplace, an icon and a privacy policy. The skill instructions are unchanged.

Install from this repository:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skill
codex plugin add anti-defensive-writing@adkid-zephyr-writing
```

Validated with a clean Codex configuration: GitHub marketplace fetch and plugin installation succeeded, and both installed SKILL.md files match the repository. The ZIP integrity and referenced assets were checked.

This GitHub release provides repository distribution and a ZIP for OpenAI submission. It is not a listing in the official ChatGPT/Codex plugin directory.
